tooltip.spellgems.raw_spell_gem.descript: Must be combined with a specific item in a crafting table to create a functional spell gem
tooltip.spellgems.spell_tome.description: Can be applied to spell gems in an anvil
tooltip.spellgems.wand.repair: Repair with Shimmersteel in an anvil, or use Mending / Recharge
tooltip.spellgems.wand.cycle: Hold %s + mouse wheel to select spell
tooltip.spellgems.astral_bow.configure: Shift + right-click to equip potion gems
tooltip.spellgems.astral_bow.cycle: Hold %s + mouse wheel to select potion
tooltip.spellgems.astral_bow.astral_arro: Does not use arrows from inventory
tooltip.spellgems.spell.projectile.name: Projectile
tooltip.spellgems.spell.projectile.descr: Shoots a projectile that deals damage to the target
tooltip.spellgems.spell.nova.name: Nova
tooltip.spellgems.spell.nova.description: Deals damage and knocks enemies back in an area around the player
tooltip.spellgems.spell.vortex.name: Vortex
tooltip.spellgems.spell.vortex.descripti: Pulls targets toward the location the player is pointing at
tooltip.spellgems.spell.blink.name: Blink
tooltip.spellgems.spell.blink.descriptio: Teleports to the block or entity you are looking at, up to a maximum range
tooltip.spellgems.spell.wind_charge.name: Wind Charge
tooltip.spellgems.spell.wind_charge.desc: Casts a wind charge exactly like the vanilla mechanic
tooltip.spellgems.spell.magnet.name: Magnet
tooltip.spellgems.spell.magnet.descripti: Pulls loose items in the area toward the player
tooltip.spellgems.spell.place_block.name: Place Block
tooltip.spellgems.spell.place_block.desc: Places a single random block from the player's hotbar onto the targeted face
tooltip.spellgems.spell.break_block.name: Break Block
tooltip.spellgems.spell.harvest.name: Harvest
tooltip.spellgems.spell.harvest.descript: Harvests all mature crops in a 9×9 area
tooltip.spellgems.spell.plant.name: Plant
tooltip.spellgems.spell.plant.descriptio: Plants seeds from the player's hotbar into a 9×9 area of farmland
tooltip.spellgems.spell.feed.name: Feed
tooltip.spellgems.spell.feed.description: Feeds/breeds animals in a 9×9 area using items from the player's hotbar
tooltip.spellgems.spell.grow.name: Grow
tooltip.spellgems.spell.grow.description: Applies bone meal effect to crops in a 9×9 area using bone meal from the player's hotbar
tooltip.spellgems.spell.potion.name: Potion
tooltip.spellgems.spell.potion.descripti: Can be enchanted with any potion
tooltip.spellgems.spell_gem_potion.astra: Can be used in an Astral Bow for a tipped arrow effect
tooltip.spellgems.spell_enchantment.chai: After hitting a target, jumps to another nearby target (maximum 5 targets total)
tooltip.spellgems.spell_enchantment.mult: Fires the spell 5 times simultaneously in a cone shape
tooltip.spellgems.spell_enchantment.pier: The spell pierces through all targets in its path
tooltip.spellgems.spell_enchantment.burs: Fires the spell 5 times in quick succession
tooltip.spellgems.spell_enchantment.infe: If the struck target is burning, applies wither and burns the ground around them
tooltip.spellgems.spell_enchantment.fros: If the struck target is freezing, creates a chilling area effect that applies freezing and wither
tooltip.spellgems.spell_enchantment.plag: If the struck target is poisoned, creates a toxic area effect that applies poison, wither and slowness
tooltip.spellgems.spell_enchantment.ligh: If the struck target is slowed, strikes it with lightning
tooltip.spellgems.spell_enchantment.expl: If the struck target is levitating, casts an explosion on it
tooltip.spellgems.spell_enchantment.drai: Heals the player for every struck target; if the target is withered, deals additional damage
tooltip.spellgems.spell_enchantment.ther: If the struck target is burning, applies freezing and levitation
tooltip.spellgems.spell_enchantment.puri: Deals extra damage; if the struck target is poisoned, sets it on fire
tooltip.spellgems.spell_enchantment.voll: If the struck target is slowed or levitating, astral arrows rain down on it
tooltip.spellgems.spell_enchantment.veng: Deals extra damage based on how low the player's health is
tooltip.spellgems.spell_enchantment.smel: Smelts items obtained by the spell
